projects.title: Banjo-Kazooie XBLA Decompilation Research
projects.platform: Xbox 360 / Xbox Live Arcade
projects.status: Early matching work. The README says contributors copy Ghidra pseudocode or functions from the N64 decompilation and test whether they match; no overall completion percentage or playable PC port is claimed.
projects.summary: Research project for the XBLA executable: split and rebuild its XEX, then compare matching code. The README warns that MSVC-built code and GCC PowerPC reference output can differ in relocations.
projects.strategy: Matching decompilation with function matching and object-diff comparison
projects.source_available: Public source repository; requires an unencrypted supported Xbox 360 XEX; no game assets are included
projects.subtype: Xbox 360 XBLA matching-decompilation research

projects.title: Tony Hawk’s Project 8 Xbox 360 PC Recompilation
projects.platform: Xbox 360 → Linux x86-64, macOS arm64, Windows x86-64 (hardware support varies)
projects.status: Release v0.3.0. Linux x86-64 is the main verified platform; macOS was tested on Apple M1 but heavy scenes are slow. Windows x86-64 was tested through Proton, not on Windows hardware. The README warns that uncapped frame rates make in-level cutscenes run too fast.
projects.summary: Ahead-of-time static recompilation translates Xbox 360 PowerPC instructions to C++ and builds a native executable. The user supplies the supported Xbox 360 disc image; game files are not included.
projects.strategy: Static PowerPC-to-C++ recompilation with a native host runtime
projects.source_available: Public source repository and release; user supplies the supported Xbox 360 game image; game data is not included
projects.subtype: Xbox 360 static recompilation for PC

projects.title: Project Gotham Racing 4 Recompilation

projects.status: Latest release v1.2.1 is an unfinished work in progress. The status page reports that UI, graphics, races, AI, and stability work, but not all cars do; the Lotus Esprit Essex Turbo fails to load.

projects.status: The README describes a ReXGlue-based native Direct3D 12 recompilation and lists graphics options, high-resolution rendering, and controller-only input. It does not identify a release or give a specific gameplay/test boundary, so maturity is unclear.
projects.summary: The Xbox 360 PowerPC executable is recompiled with ReXGlue for a native Windows build and Direct3D 12 renderer. The user must supply the extracted game data; the README says the port currently supports a controller and displays letterboxing on non-16:9 screens.

projects.title: Burnout Revenge Xbox 360 Recompilation (Fabioap)
projects.platform: Xbox 360 → Windows x86-64
projects.status: Experimental source release, actively in progress. The owner reports title/menu access, save/load, full 3D car selection, race entry and a complete multi-race session without observed crashes. A rendering issue remains on several menu/pause screens, and the alpha-level session has not yet been independently reproduced.
projects.summary: Static Xbox 360 PowerPC-to-C++ recompilation using ReXGlue on Windows AMD64. The repository includes a customized SDK copy, build configuration and a dated project-state log; user-supplied game files are required.
projects.strategy: Static PowerPC-to-C++ recompilation using ReXGlue
projects.source_available: Public source repository and experimental source release; user supplies extracted Xbox 360 game files; no game data or compiled executable included
projects.subtype: Xbox 360 static recompilation; Windows x64 target
